title: Nonparametric Regression with Measurement Error in Banach Spaces
summary: We consider nonparametric regression with a Banach-space-valued predictor where the covariate takes values in a general separable Banach space. Our primary objective is to develop a unified framework for estimating the regression operator without relying on an inner-product structure, thereby extending classical and functional nonparametric regression beyond Euclidean and Hilbert spaces in the presence of measurement error.
